edges.reason: Owner state variable is initialized directly from the untrusted msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
transfer debits and credits balances keyed on the untrusted msg.sender.
approve writes the allowed mapping indexed by msg.sender.
transferFrom deducts the allowance of msg.sender and moves funds of the from account.
approveAndCall sets allowance for msg.sender and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before transferring ownership.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the external receiveApproval callback.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to guard against balance underflow.
transfer calls safeAdd to guard against balance overflow.
approve writes the allowance entry in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates the balances of the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decreases the allowance stored in allowed.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance deduction.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
approveAndCall stores the allowance in allowed before calling out.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the untrusted spender contract.
The external call invokes receiveApproval on the untrusted spender contract.
Control returns from the untrusted callback to approveAndCall after state was already written, enabling reentrancy.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed token supply.
Constructor mints the entire supply into the balances mapping.
Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts the balance of address(0).
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner address.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract supplied by the owner.
The arbitrary external token call can re-enter the contract through the payable fallback path.
